transcript: Speaker A: Stop saying I don't understand, I am busy, It's okay. Stop saying these basic English phrases. Main bhi pehle exactly aise English bolti thi. Fir mujhe SpeakEasy App par AI English teacher Vani mili. Aao dikhati hoon. [Stop saying I don't understand, I am busy, It's okay. Stop saying these basic English phrases. I also used to speak English exactly like this before. Then I found AI English teacher Vani on the SpeakEasy App. Come, let me show you.] Speaker A: Sorry, meri English speaking weak hai. [Sorry, my English speaking is weak.] Speaker B: Koi baat nahi. Roz thodi practice se English improve ho jati hai. [No problem. With a little practice every day, English improves.] Speaker A: Par mere paas daily practice karne ke liye koi partner nahi hai. [But I don't have any partner to practice with daily.] Speaker B: Isliye to main hoon. Main tumhari AI English teacher hoon. Tum jab chaho mere saath English practice kar sakti ho. [That's why I'm here. I am your AI English teacher. You can practice English with me whenever you want.] Speaker A: Sach mein! Main tumse anytime baat kar sakti hoon? [Really! I can talk to you anytime?] Speaker B: Of course, main tumhari pronunciation improve karungi, instant feedback dungi, aur har conversation ke saath tumhari English better banaungi. [Of course, I will improve your pronunciation, give instant feedback, and make your English better with every conversation.] Speaker A: Par mujhe grammar mein bahut mistakes hoti hain. [But I make a lot of mistakes in grammar.] Speaker B: Mistakes ki tension mat lo. Main tumhari mistakes correct karungi aur step-by-step guide bhi karungi. Mere saath practice karo aur fir tum khud dekhogi ki kitni jaldi tumhari English improve hoti hai. [Don't worry about mistakes. I will correct your mistakes and guide you step-by-step. Practice with me and then you will see for yourself how quickly your English improves.] Speaker A: Agar aap bhi Hindi ke through confidently English bolna seekhna chahte ho, to roz bas 10-15 minute AI English teacher Vani ke saath practice karo. [If you also want to learn to speak English confidently through Hindi, then just practice for 10-15 minutes daily with AI English teacher Vani.] Speaker C: Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: STOP SAYING 🚫 / I don't understand / I am busy / It's okay / SpeakEasy App / AI English teacher / Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy / Install Now
summary: A young woman demonstrates how she practices English using the SpeakEasy app's AI teacher, Vani. The AI avatar provides real-time corrections, pronunciation feedback, and grammar guidance. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app on Google Play or the App Store.
